text: Someone keyed my car in the supermarket car park. Whole side. I'm shaking with rage.
Duncan called me 'sweetheart' in front of the client and then talked over me for the rest of the meeting. I am livid.
The school knew about the bullying for weeks and did nothing. My son came home with a bruise today.
Furious at the landlord. He let himself into the flat without notice. Again.
Found out Ray has been lying about where the money went. Two years of lying.
So angry I had to go for a walk before I said something I'd regret. Still angry after the walk.
The airline lost my bag, then lied about it, then hung up on me.
Watched the news about the factory dumping waste in the river and I'm genuinely enraged.
Quinn read my private messages. I can't even look at her right now.
Manager blamed me in front of everyone for a mistake that was his. I said nothing. I'm boiling.
Cyclist nearly took me out on the crossing and then swore at ME.
Brother borrowed the car, returned it on empty with a dent and said 'it was like that'.
The doctor dismissed my pain AGAIN. 'Probably stress.' I've had this for a year.
Uncle Desmond said something horrible about my wife at dinner and everyone laughed. I walked out.
Fuming. They gave the promotion to the guy who's been here six months and does half the work.
Someone stole the bike from right outside the station. Cut the lock. In daylight.
I'm so mad at myself for trusting Victor after everything. Signed the contract without reading it properly.
The company cancelled our pensions with a two-line email. Thirty years.
Saw a man kick his dog in the park. Shouted at him. Hands still trembling.
Angry that the train company keeps raising prices while the trains get worse.
Tasha told everyone my secret. The one thing I asked her not to.
Got overcharged by the mechanic, then he refused to show me the old part. I'm reporting him.
Hate how they talk about people like my mum on that show. She worked two jobs her whole life.
Nobody on the team stood up for me in the review. Not one person. I'm seething.
Kerry-Ann's ex showed up at her work and made a scene. I wanted to throw him into the road.
The neighbours had a party until 4am on a Tuesday. Kids had school. I banged on the door and they laughed.
Absolutely raging. The council towed my car from my own street because of a sign they put up yesterday.
My mother-in-law rearranged my kitchen while I was out. Every cupboard. 'Helping'.
The school cancelled the trip because two parents complained. Thirty kids devastated. I'm so angry for them.
Patrice made a racist joke at work and HR says it's 'a matter of interpretation'.
I asked for one thing for my birthday: no drama. Dad brought drama.
The scammers got Grandma's savings. Police say there's little they can do. I want to scream.
Furious about the hospital wait. Dad was on a trolley in the corridor for fourteen hours.
He said I was 'too emotional' for the role. I wrote a calm email back. I am not calm.
Livid that Marco cancelled my shift without asking and gave it to his friend.
The building management turned off the heating in the middle of winter 'to save costs'. There are babies here.
Rage. My essay was plagiarised by someone in my class and he got the higher mark.
Still angry about what Jasmine said. Can't stop rehearsing all the things I should have said back.
They built the fence two metres onto our land and the surveyor says it's 'within tolerance'.
Someone left their dog in a hot car outside the shops. Called the police. Waited with the dog. Seething.
My boss read my private email over my shoulder and commented on it in the meeting.
Absolutely incensed that the hospital lost Mum's test results. Again. She has to redo the whole thing.
Lennart made fun of my accent in front of the new hires. Pretended it was a joke. It wasn't.
I'm angry, and I'm allowed to be angry. They broke the promise they made to the kids.
Car dealer sold me a lemon and now won't return calls. I'm going down there tomorrow.
Hate that I cried when I was angry in the meeting. It makes them think I'm upset instead of furious.
The guy at the bar wouldn't leave Inès alone. Bouncer did nothing. We left. Still fuming.
They demolished the old cinema without telling anyone. Woke up to rubble.
Mad at my sister for missing Mum's birthday dinner with no excuse.
Ruined my whole evening thinking about Gordon's email. Condescending, passive-aggressive, cc'd everyone.
Fury is the only word. Someone poisoned the stray cats behind the shop.
Irritated going on angry. Customer screamed at me over a coupon that expired in 2019.
I trusted Darius with the keys and he threw a party in my flat. Broken glass everywhere.
The insurance company denied the claim after the flood. The flood they insured us for.
Not upset. Angry. There's a difference and today it's anger.
Bea's father grabbed her arm in the restaurant and I saw red. Told him to let go. He did.
Fumed the whole commute. The new policy means we lose our flexible hours with one week's notice.
Hit-and-run on our street. Mrs. Ansah's cat. The driver didn't even slow down.
I am so angry at the system that let my brother fall through every crack.
Gareth posted the photo I asked him not to post. Then said I was overreacting.
Seething at the referee. Clear foul, no call, we lost the cup.
My ex is telling people lies about why we split. I'm trying to rise above it. I'm not rising.
Tradesman took the deposit and disappeared. £800.
Sophie's teacher shouted at her in front of the class for asking to go to the toilet. She came home crying.
Raging at the bank. They closed my account with no warning and my salary bounced.
Mild anger. Someone took my lunch from the office fridge. Labelled and everything.
After everything I did for Yasmin, she didn't even invite me to the wedding.
The court let him off with a warning. A warning.
Angry at the whole situation. At the illness, at the waiting lists, at how unfair it all is.
Teammate deleted my branch 'by accident' the night before the demo. Lost a day of work. Hard to believe it was an accident.
